title: MAVIS: A Benchmark for Multimodal Source Attribution in Long-form Visual Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether models fabricate plausible but ungrounded answers due to the influence of the user question and input image. This is measured by comparing baseline response groundedness against a pipeline with an isolated Knowledge Extraction (KE) step that hides the user inputs.

Measuring models' preference for textual information over visual information (text dominance) by calculating document utilization ratios and groundedness precision for text versus image documents, and running controlled experiments that vary the number of text documents to observe the drop in image attention.
